name: Engine ability library
_note: The special abilities the engine implements. A unit type opts into one by id and may set its params (anything left out takes the default here). listed: false -- works, but is not shown in the unit's ability list. A new ability needs engine code.

abilities.name: Mustering
abilities.description: Mustering: can be deployed in contested territory

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.description: Amphibious: becomes a transport in sea spaces (the only land unit that can enter the water)

abilities.name: Blitz
abilities.description: Blitz: a combat move may pass through an undefended enemy territory, capturing it

abilities.name: Transport
abilities.description: See transport & amphibious operations rules; a Mechanized Infantry unit becomes a transport in a sea space, one transport per unit, with no move bonus

abilities.name: Air Superiority
abilities.description: Air Superiority: {attack_die} attack, {damage} damage in the pre-combat air superiority round
abilities._note: attack_die/damage null: the unit rolls its normal die and damage in that round. triggers_round: the round happens when both sides have aircraft and one of them has a unit that triggers it.

abilities.name: Interception
abilities.description: Interception: enemy aircraft cannot fly over a space it holds

abilities.name: Carrier Air Wing
abilities.description: Carrier Air Wing: carries up to {capacity} air units

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.description: Submerge: can't engage or be attacked by aircraft

abilities.name: Bombardment
abilities.description: Bombardment: can do 1 bombardment round against land as Combat Move

abilities.name: Indiscriminate
abilities.description: Indiscriminate: picks targets without the same-type preference
